name: Tokuyoshi Yuuko
source: Third-year high school student and [url=/c10457]Haruto's[/url] childhood friend. She is a cheerful girl that likes taking care of others, therefore she is very popular at school. She is in love with Haruto, but is too stubborn to admit her feelings. After meeting [url=/c10367]Ayano[/url], she moves in with them and began to express her feelings more openly.
